description: Elections Commission - M. L. P. P. K. Liyanage, H. M. R. M. Herath and J. M. Somawathie of the Pannala Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific members of the Pannala Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which includes matters concerning electoral boundaries, candidate registrations, and declarations about elected officials.
